svg.title: Жим гантелей поочерёдно лёжа — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. ALTERNATING DUMBBELL BENCH PRESS. Both figures lie face up on flat bench, feet floor, ONE dumbbell EACH hand. Left pose: LEFT arm holds dumbbell EXTENDED vertically above chest while RIGHT elbow is bent with right dumbbell at chest. Right pose: RIGHT arm now EXTENDED above chest while LEFT elbow is bent and left dumbbell at chest. Clearly alternating, never both arms bent or both extended simultaneously. Same torso/bench and camera. Detailed hollow contours. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
